Around 5:30 PM October 23, 2026,Thunderstorms developed over Pomona/Diamond Bar and moved south over Chino Hills into NE Orange County affecting Placentia and Yorba Linda before drifting SW into Fullerton and Anaheim. Precipitation had ended by 8:00 PM leaving storm drains overwhelmed with access lids lifted off in the roadway, streets and intersections flooded nearly 12 inches deep with flowing water in places up to 8 inches leaving a few cars stranded. There were reports of power lines down or arcing, a palm tree caught fire and urban street flooding.
